leverage.exposure: None. The balance is positive, no offer is outstanding, and no leveraged position is open or proposed. This is the condition to protect: a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the whole matchday, and the lock is Friday evening. Every structure examined this run that reaches a top-of-board player ends leveraged with no legal route back to positive before the lock, which is why they were all declined regardless of merit.

binding_gap: The binding constraint is liquidity, not any position on the pitch. Every slot is filled and legal, so there is no hole to plug; what is missing is the cash to convert a weak slot into a strong one. The gap is between what one unwind can raise and what the cheapest genuine upgrade on the board costs, and that gap is currently wide enough that no single trade closes it. It will not close by waiting for prices to fall either — the good listings are at market value, not above it. It closes only if a sale banks money without costing fielded points, and the two newly-flagged players are the first candidates in weeks who could plausibly do that.

verdict.headline: No action.
verdict.detail: No action. Nothing on the board is both affordable and points-positive, so the trading verdict is the same quiet no it has been all week — but the squad news is not quiet. Two of the fielded eleven picked up knocks today and both were confirmed by dated sources this run: Sambi Lokonga (back) and Widmer (knee). Neither is described as structural, neither has a return timeline, and MD3 does not lock until Friday evening, so there is time. There is also, today, nothing legal to do about it: the squad is at exactly eleven, so no player can be sold until a buy lands first, and this run's sweep found nothing under the ceiling that outscores the men it would replace. Watch the two status flags on every run between now and the lock; act only if one is still flagged at the point a buy becomes affordable.

sell.reason: No sale is recommended, and none is legal today — selling from a squad of eleven drops it to ten and triggers the penalty, so a sale can only follow a buy. The disposition has changed underneath, though. Lokonga was already the worst points-per-euro body in the squad and the designated unwind lever; he is now also carrying a back problem that kept him out of today's match. If he is still flagged when a purchase finally becomes affordable, the unwind stops being a trade-off and becomes free — sell him ahead of Conté or Widmer. Widmer is the same story at a smaller scale: already a non-starter, now also knocked, and at his market value he funds nothing regardless. Guirassy, Gregoritsch, Nusa, Matsima, Minjae, Onyeka, ter Horst and Baumann are all fit, all scoring, and none should be touched.

standing.name: Sambi Lokonga
standing.why: THE UNWIND LEG OF BUY Bsmq4uu - CONDITIONAL, AND THE CONDITION IS NOT OPTIONAL. Sell him ONLY once Rohr has actually landed (check get_squad, per H5om1wi do not trust the calibration table's [executed] flag). At 11 players a sale is a -100 penalty; at 12 it is free. If the Rohr auction is lost, CLOSE THIS CALL AND KEEP HIM - this supersedes nothing about his standing block, which already says exactly that. WHY HIM AND NOT CONTE, the only other candidate: on points they are a coin flip (Lokonga ap 44 v Conte ap 47, so Conte is fractionally better and the Lokonga route is worth +3 fielded points because it keeps Widmer 29 in a 5-2-3 rather than dropping Conte 47 from a 5-3-2 - 1283 v 1280). The tiebreak is the money. Lokonga is BLEEDING: mvt 2, sdmvt -1.125.317, i.e. roughly -1,1M a day, and he is the worst points-per-euro in the squad at 9.731.816 / 44 = 221k per point. Conte is RISING hard: mvt 1, sdmvt +1.284.273, tfhmvt +93.437. Sell the decaying asset and keep the appreciating one. SELECTION CUTS THE OTHER WAY AND IS DELIBERATELY OVERRIDDEN: Lokonga is a confirmed HSV starter (no news dated 04.09.2026 or later; note the hsv.de "Verletzungsupdate zu Sambi Lokonga" ankle-ligament story is 09.02.2026 = LAST SEASON and was correctly discarded again this run), while Conte was BENCHED by Hoffenheim v Dortmund on 05.09.2026 (sport.de liveticker; rotated for Lemperle and Rots). That argues for selling Conte instead. It is outweighed by the mv trajectories: Conte benched but appreciating is still the better asset to hold, and a start is not points. FORMATION DEPENDENCY, THE ONE THING THAT COULD FORCE THE SWITCH: this route leaves 1GK/5DEF/2MID/3ATT and needs 5-2-3 to be selectable. If the app does not offer 5-2-3, sell CONTE instead (9.292.405, leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2, definitely legal, 1280 fielded, and the bid was sized so that route also stays positive at +45.172). Verify the shape in-app before clicking; do not discover it after the sale. Instant-sale to Kickbase pays exactly mv, measured 8 for 8.

standing.name: Albert Sambi Lokonga

Fires ONLY if Rohr lands at ~00:57Z; if the auction is lost, do NOT sell, the squad is 11 and legal at 4-3-3. (1) WHY HIM. ap 44 on mv 9.771.142 = 222k per fielded point, the worst points-per-euro body in the squad that is large enough to fund the buy (Widmer is cheaper per point but only 1,9M, nowhere near the 10,7M needed). Selling him leaves 1GK/5DEF/2MID/3ATT = 5-2-3, legal; fielded eleven 1226 - 44 + 101 = 1283. Selling Conte instead gives 5-3-2 at 1280 AND realises a 2,5M loss on a player bought today at 12.000.000, so Lokonga is strictly better on both counts. (2) THE TIMING RULE, WHICH SUPERSEDES "SELL IMMEDIATELY". CORRECTED CLUB FACT: Lokonga is HAMBURGER SV, not Leipzig - ligainsider 2026/27 profile says Hamburger SV, and the lineup `os` field (MD3 opponent) reads RBL, mirroring Nusa's HSV. tid 6 = HSV; record it. HSV have NOT yet played MD2 (mdst 0) - they play Sunday 06.09. Selling a player before his matchday game forfeits his MD2 points. SO: SELL AFTER HSV'S SUNDAY MATCH ENDS (~17:30Z) AND BEFORE THE 20:00Z MARKET-VALUE TICK. In that window mv is fixed at 9.771.142 and the unwind is arithmetically certain: 1.002.767 - 10.700.000 + 9.771.142 = +73.909. (3) IF THE WINDOW IS MISSED the position is not urgent - MD3 does not lock until 2026-09-11T18:30Z, ~142h out - but the buffer is only 73.909, so a downward tick on Lokonga (sdmvt -1.060.385, i.e. he has been drifting down) puts the balance negative. A NEGATIVE BALANCE AT MD3 KICKOFF SCORES ZERO FOR THE ENTIRE MATCHDAY. Emergency fallback if Lokonga's mv slips below ~9,70M: sell Minjae (12.237.277) or Matsima (14.399.505) instead - both clear it with room, at a real points cost, and both keep a legal shape. Do not let the buffer be the reason the position is left open. (4) NEWS: no dated item since 03.08.2026 ("Lokonga mischt wieder mit"); absent from ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte 05.09; 81% Einsatzquote, 4,0 average, 26th among central midfielders. He is FIT and probably starting - this is a QUALITY sale, not an availability one, and the case rests entirely on 222k per point being the worst funding cost in the squad. GEORG EXECUTES; this task never places trades.

standing.name: Amoako
standing.why: THE UNWIND. This is the pre-priced second leg of the Conte trade and it is now due. Conte (3204) settled to Georg Kitz 2026-09-05T12:52:14Z at 12.000.000 against mv 9.292.405 = +29,14%, exactly the Brncinm call, and the balance is now -566.376. Selling Amoako to Kickbase at mv 1.569.143 puts it at +1.002.767 and closes the leveraged position outright. REVERSES AND CLOSES Hjmhal7, WHICH SAID DO NOT SELL HIM - say that out loud to Georg. Hjmhal7 was right on its own premise and the premise is dead: it protected Amoako as the ELEVENTH BODY of an 11-man squad, where selling him meant 10 players and the -100 penalty. Conte makes the squad TWELVE, so Amoako is now the twelfth body and the sale is free. POINTS COST ZERO, MEASURED: Amoako has no ap field at all (0 points, 0 minutes, 0 apps, 2x unused sub per Ligainsider 05.09.2026), so he leaves the fielded eleven at 12 players anyway. Squad after the sale is 11 = 1GK/4DEF/3MID/3ATT, which IS 4-3-3 exactly, legal, fully placed, fielded points 1439. HE IS THE RIGHT BODY AND THE ALTERNATIVE IS MEASURED: selling Widmer instead (mv 1.852.587, +283.444 more cash) forces 3-4-3 and costs 29 fielded points; selling Lokonga (mv 9.731.816) forces Amoako back into the eleven and costs 44. Amoako is the only points-free sale on the books. TIMING - SELL BEFORE 20:00Z: market values tick at 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z (mvud, first-party) and Amoako is decaying hard - tfhmvt -49.393, sdmvt -811.827 - so every tick he is held costs ~50k of unwind. There is no matchday risk forcing the hand (MD3 locks 2026-09-11T18:30Z, ~149,6h away, and MD2's lock passed 04.09 18:30Z with the balance still at +11.433.624, so no scored matchday has ever seen the negative), but there is no reason on earth to wait either. AFTER THIS THE SQUAD IS AT 11 AND FULLY INVESTED: cash ~1,00M, zero further sales possible without triggering -100, so the usable buy ceiling is ~1,00M and nothing on the board is reachable. That is the correct state, not a problem to solve.

buy.reason: Nothing to buy. The board is unusually well stocked at the top and the whole of it sits beyond reach: Kane, Olise, Upamecano, Laimer, Brown, Beier, Mittelstädt and now Schick are all listed at exactly market value and every one of them is a multiple of what a single unwind can fund. Schick is the one worth naming, because he is not merely another big name priced out — he is the best marginal buy this ledger has ever measured. Two starts, fit, in Leverkusen's XI as of a source dated this week, and he would replace the weakest attacker rather than duplicate a slot, which is what makes his cost per marginal point roughly half of the next best large listing ever considered here. He runs until Tuesday midday, the longest runway on the board. He is still a no today on money alone, and the note is filed so that if a sale ever banks real dry powder without costing fielded points, no run has to rediscover him. Below the ceiling there is nothing at all: the entire affordable field is the zero-average class — Chandler, Porath, Jakić, Duric, Millgramm, Boss, Chiarodia — plus Poulsen, who carries a negative average, and Vidović, who is a downgrade on the midfielder he would replace. Injured or suspended listings are excluded as usual: Emre Can, Leopold, Prass, Asllani and El Mala all carry non-zero status flags.

standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: SUPERSEDES Bsmq4uu (closed, not abandoned): SAME PLAYER, RAISED PRICE 10.250.000 -> 10.700.000. THE MERIT CASE IS UNCHANGED AND RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN; ONLY THE ARITHMETIC MOVED. (1) WHY RAISE. The 20:00Z tick lifted Rohr's mv 9.726.134 -> 9.863.244 (+1,41%), so the standing 10.250.000 bid fell from +5,39% to +3,92% over mv without anyone doing anything. prc is now 9.863.244 and the offer still clears it (ofc 1, ofs = Georg Kitz alone, uop 10.250.000), so nothing is broken - but a bid that drifts DOWN in premium terms while a listing runs is exactly the passive posture H5om1wi condemns. (2) H5om1wi APPLIES DIRECTLY. This is a KICKBASE listing = highest-bid-wins at expiry, so raising buys win probability outright (unlike a manager ask, Hlovt4t seller's choice). exs 15148 = resolves ~2026-09-06T00:57Z, roughly 4,2h out. The 2-hourly cadence gives one more look at ~22:45Z and a marginal one at ~00:45Z, twelve minutes before expiry - the Makengo window precisely. Makengo was ofc 1 with Georg alone eight hours before expiry and cleared to a rival at +60,76%. ofc is a snapshot, not a forecast. (3) CALIBRATION SAYS BID HIGH. Record to date: bid high and won once (Onyeka +54,37%, still a 139-point fielded MID); bid low and lost twice (Gomis bid +40,18% cleared +48,28%; Makengo bid +13,03% cleared +60,76%). On a points mandate overpaying is recoverable, losing the asset is not. (4) THE CEILING, RECOMPUTED THIS RUN. Buying takes the squad to 12 = 1GK/5DEF/3MID/3ATT and the unwind need NOT be a defender: selling Lokonga leaves 1/5/2/3 = 5-2-3, legal. Ceiling = cash 1.002.767 + Lokonga mv 9.771.142 (ticked up 39.326 tonight) = 10.773.909. 10.700.000 leaves 73.909 positive after the unwind. THIS IS THE AFFORDABILITY CEILING, NOT A JUDGEMENT THAT +8,49% IS ENOUGH - the contested-Kickbase cluster runs +16% to +61% and we cannot reach it without stranding a negative balance. (5) NEWS RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-05, ALL DATED IN PERIOD: eurosport.de live-lineup for Gladbach v Elversberg 05.09.2026 names Rohr in the CONFIRMED Elversberg back four; ligainsider 04.09.2026 "Wagner: Vertrauen in bewaehrtes Abwehr-Trio"; ligainsider 31.08.2026 clears the MD1 substitution as exhaustion, not injury; he is ABSENT from ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte fetched this run; contract to 2028, no exit risk; st 0. p 202 / ap 101 over two starts. 97,7k per fielded point at the new mv - better than every outfielder Georg owns except Gregoritsch, ter Horst and Onyeka. Fielded eleven 1226 -> 1283 (+57) on the Lokonga unwind. (6) SEQUENCING IS UNCHANGED AND NOT OPTIONAL: RAISE FIRST, SELL AFTER. A lost auction after a sale leaves the squad at 10 and the -100 penalty. Mechanically this is remove_offer then place_offer at 10.700.000 - GEORG EXECUTES, this task never places trades. (7) FIXTURE CAVEAT FOR THE NEXT RUN, NEWLY DERIVED: the lineup `os` field is the MD3 OPPONENT, not MD2. Elversberg's MD3 is v BAYERN (Minjae's os is ELV, mirroring it), so Rohr's MD2 haul of ~115 came at Gladbach and his first Georg matchday is the hardest fixture on the board. That is priced in - the buy is for the season, not for MD3 alone - but do not extrapolate ~115 into MD3.

standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: CONDITIONAL ON THE 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z MARKET-VALUE TICK, WHICH IS 1h13m AWAY AND WILL VERY LIKELY PUT THE LIVE 10.250.000 OFFER UNDERWATER. This does not revise BUY Bsmq4uu (still open, still correct at the current ask); it is the contingency that Bsmq4uu itself asked the next run to price. STATE OF THE OFFER AT 18:45Z: listing prc 9.726.134 = exactly mv, ofc 1 with Georg alone in ofs at 10.250.000 = +5,39%, exs 22363 resolving ~2026-09-06T01:07Z. WHY THE TICK IS THE PROBLEM: Rohr posted ~115 points in MD2 (p 87 -> 202, ap 101) and mvt reads 1 (rising). Every Kickbase listing observed in this ledger carries prc == mv exactly, so the ask moves with the tick. The measured magnitude of a big-matchday tick, taken from this run's own squad sdmvt figures, is +9% to +34%: ter Horst scored 143 and moved +2.244.127 on 8.797.749 = +25,5%; Onyeka scored 139 and moved +2.024.477 on 9.286.468 = +21,8%; Conte scored 106 and moved +1.284.273 on 9.292.405 = +13,8%; Gregoritsch 195 -> +11,8%; Minjae 110 -> +11,8%; Matsima 138 -> +9,0%. Rohr at ~115 sits squarely in that band, so a post-tick mv of roughly 10,7M to 12,2M is the central expectation and +5,39% of headroom does not cover it. THE DECISION RULE, so the 20:45Z run does not re-derive it: re-read list_market at 20:05Z. (a) If the new prc is at or under 10.250.000, do nothing - the standing offer still clears. (b) If the new prc is above 10.250.000 but the affordability ceiling still covers it, RAISE to the ceiling. (c) If the new prc exceeds the ceiling, the buy is DEAD on affordability and the offer should be pulled rather than left to fail. THE CEILING MUST BE RECOMPUTED AT 20:05Z, NOT REUSED FROM HERE - this is the trap in this call. It is cash 1.002.767 plus the single sale a post-buy squad of 12 permits, and BOTH unwind legs move at the same tick in OPPOSITE directions. Lokonga is mvt 2 FALLING with sdmvt -1.125.317 and scored only 44, so his 9.731.816 will probably shrink; Conte is mvt 1 RISING with sdmvt +1.284.273 and scored 106, so his 9.292.405 will probably grow. Take the LARGER of the two post-tick values: selling Lokonga leaves 1/5/2/3 = 5-2-3 fielding 1283, selling Conte leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2 fielding 1280, a three-point difference that is not worth defending against a cash difference of a million. 10.734.583 recorded here is the PRE-TICK Lokonga-route ceiling and is a placeholder for that computation. WHY RAISING IS RIGHT RATHER THAN MERELY TOLERABLE, WHICH THE HEADLINE PRICE HIDES: the purchase is not P for 101 points, it is (P minus the unwind proceeds) for the NET points gain. Post-buy-and-unwind the eleven goes 1226 -> 1283, i.e. +57 fielded points, for a net cash outlay of P - 9.731.816. At the current 10.250.000 that is 518.184 for +57 = 9,1k per marginal point; even at the full 10.734.583 ceiling it is 1.002.767 for +57 = 17,6k per marginal point. Set that against the bar this ledger has been applying to everything else on the board - Conte 107k, Kosugi 351k rejected, Demirovic 465k, Robin Koch 184k gross - and Rohr is an order of magnitude better than anything else available. So the ceiling is a hard money constraint and NOT a judgement that the extra premium is unattractive: pay it if it fits. AND PER H5om1wi, RAISING ON A KICKBASE LISTING BUYS WIN PROBABILITY, because these are highest-bid-wins rather than seller's choice - this is the exact configuration in which the Makengo bid was held at +13,03% and lost to +60,76%. ofc 1 now is a snapshot, not a forecast, and the listing sits six hours out, which is the late-contest window that doctrine describes. NEWS VERIFIED THIS RUN, ALL DATED 05.09.2026: he started at CB and played the full 90 in Elversberg's 4:3 win at Gladbach (news.de match report, 05.09.2026, no substitution and no injury noted); Ligainsider's Elversberg page has him in the XI and Elversberg's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte entries are only Seifert and Zimmerschied; he is absent from Ligainsider's league-wide injury table read this run. st 0. He is now 3/3 starts. Fitness and selection are not in question - only the price is.

POULSEN (1865) ATT, tid 6 = HAMBURGER SV, mv/prc 1.635.200, listed 2026-09-06T15:25:30Z (feed t:3), st 0, mvt 2 FALLING, exs 52949 resolving ~2026-09-07T07:27Z. p -9 ap -9 - a NEGATIVE average, so he does not merely fail to add points, he SUBTRACTS them, and as an ATT he would displace Conte 47 for a swing of -56. He joins Moerstedt (-41) and Schallenberg (-54) in the negative-ap subclass, which is strictly worse than the zeros. MILLGRAMM (12262) ATT, tid 29 = SC PADERBORN, mv/prc 3.184.712, listed 2026-09-06T12:07:30Z (feed t:3), st 0, mvt 2 FALLING, exs 117989 resolving ~2026-09-08T01:31Z. NEITHER IS NEWS-CHECKED AND DELIBERATELY SO: they fail on first-party point data before a sweep is warranted, which is the standing doctrine this ledger has now applied to roughly fifteen listings. THE SHAPE POINT THAT KILLS BOTH TWICE OVER: they are ATTs, and the fielded eleven is full at 11/11 with Conte 47 the weakest attacker - a body only pays if its ap beats the man it displaces, and a negative number and a blank cannot beat 47. They are also the two cheapest things on the board, which is exactly why they need logging: a future run scanning for something affordable will stop on them, and affordable-and-worthless is still worthless. killed_this_run.name: Patrik Schick
killed_this_run.why: THE BEST MARGINAL-POINTS BUY THIS LEDGER HAS EVER MEASURED AND HE IS STILL UNAFFORDABLE - LOG THE MERIT IN FULL, because unlike Kane, Olise, Laimer or Brown this one would be worth doing the moment money exists. New Kickbase board listing 2026-09-06T14:16:34Z (feed t:3), ATT, tid 7 = BAYER 04 LEVERKUSEN, prc exactly mv 29.783.535, ofc 0, st 0, mvt 1 RISING, exs 154773 resolving ~2026-09-08T11:44Z, i.e. roughly 43 hours - the longest runway of anything on the board. p 402 ap 201 over TWO appearances, so the mean is genuinely founded and not a cameo figure. NEWS-CHECKED THIS RUN AND HE PASSES CLEANLY, which is why he is worth the ink: Ligainsider's 26/27 profile gives 2 STARTS and 164 minutes, lists him as fit and in the starting lineup, and his newest items are 04.09.2026 "Martinez ordnet ein: Maza auf der Zehn, Diaby rechts" and 21.08.2026 - no fitness concern of any kind in the current season. The old "Verletzungssorgen bei Leverkusen: Wie lange fehlt Schick?" material is not current-season and was correctly discarded. THE MARGINAL MATHS, AND IT IS THE BEST NUMBER IN THIS LEDGER: an ATT buy displaces Conte 47, so the real purchase is +154 FIELDED POINTS for 29.783.535 = 193k PER MARGINAL POINT. Compare every large rejection on record - Beier 344k, Kosugi 351k, Demirovic 465k, Laimer 427k, Nathaniel Brown 752k, Nmecha 735k, Kane 1,38M. Nothing else has come within 150k of him, and the only cheaper marginal buys ever logged (Conte 107k, Rohr 112k) were small trades, not a +154 swing. WHY IT IS STILL A NO: the squad is ELEVEN, so one buy permits exactly ONE sale, and the only unwind that returns a legal shape after an ATT purchase is Conte at mv 9.456.481. Ceiling = cash 1.102.767 + 9.456.481 = 10.559.248 against a 29.783.535 ask - short by 19.224.287, a factor of 2,82. DO NOT REACH FOR A BIGGER UNWIND: the only ATT sales that size are Guirassy (30.623.276, ap 213) and Gregoritsch (12.164.007, ap 195), and swapping either for ap 201 nets +/-12 points for a 30M churn. AND DO NOT BUILD THE TWO-BUY LEVERAGE STRUCTURE: buying Schick plus a cheap body to unlock two sales (Conte + Lokonga) still leaves roughly -10,8M with no further sales legal, i.e. a NEGATIVE balance into the 2026-09-11T18:30Z lock, which scores ZERO for the entire matchday. That risk outranks +154 points and every other consideration. REVERSAL - AND THIS ONE IS REAL, NOT THEORETICAL: if a sale ever banks 28,7M+ of dry powder without costing more than 154 fielded points, he is the single best use of it on this board. Re-verify his Leverkusen selection on a source dated at that time and re-check that his ap has not re-based (it will move to a three-match mean after MD3), but do NOT re-derive the affordability case - it is here.

New Kickbase board listing 2026-09-06T12:07:30Z (feed t:3), ATT, tid 29 = PADERBORN, prc exactly mv 3.184.712, ofc 0, st 0, mvt 2 FALLING, exs 125179 resolving ~2026-09-07T22:53Z. list_market returns NO p and NO ap at all - no Kickbase-scored minutes in 26/27 - so the standing test from Atq95vh/Atracig disposes of him without argument: a twelfth body only pays if its ap beats the man it would displace, and as an ATT he would displace Conte 47. A zero does not beat a 47. He is also from the same Paderborn squad as Duric (Atracig) and ter Horst, and shares Duric's profile exactly: cheap, falling, no minutes.
